description: Frozen data files used by the scripts, with their SHA-256 hashes. scripts/evaluate.py refuses to run if mmlu_dev.jsonl does not match splits.mmlu_dev.sha256 and checks both format-validation files against their deterministic selection.

mmlu_dev.source: cais/mmlu, config all, split validation (1,531 items)
mmlu_dev.rule: Remove every validation item whose group also contains an item of the upstream test split, and collapse duplicates within validation; 41 items removed. Items are grouped on two keys at once: the normalised question with its options sorted, and the normalised question stem alone.

fields.i: row index in the upstream validation file (0-1530)
fields.question: upstream question text
fields.subject: upstream subject
fields.key: hash of the normalised question with its options in upstream order
fields.gkey: hash of the normalised question with its options sorted (group key for de-duplication)
fields.stem: hash of the normalised question alone

format_validation.rule: 5 per subject, ascending SHA256(JSON([20260911, item_id])). Used only to select the prompt format; excluded from the subset below.

format_validation_r5.rule: Same ordering as format_validation, excluding its items, up to 5 per subject; subjects with fewer remaining items contribute what remains.
format_validation_r5.parser: complete uppercase A/B/C/D, optional period, whitespace

alpaca.source: tatsu-lab/alpaca (Stanford Alpaca); text = instruction, plus a blank line and the input when present; response = output
